meta.title: NGSD: Your External Software Department
meta.description: NGSD (Next Generation Software Department) gives you an assigned Genixo project manager and team that work as your software department, every month.

hero.title: A software department, without building one
hero.lead: An assigned Genixo project manager becomes your software manager, and the Genixo team becomes your software department. We set priorities together and show what's done every week.

answer.label: In short
answer.text: NGSD (Next Generation Software Department) is Genixo's ongoing service model: a project manager assigned to your company and a Genixo engineering team that handle your software work month after month. Priorities are set with you, finished work is shown every week, everything is documented, and the code and knowledge can be handed over if you build your own team.

sections.label: Why NGSD
sections.title: Software needs are continuous. A permanent team isn't always the right investment.
paragraphs: Hiring, combining different skills and keeping a software team takes serious time and money. Many companies need a backend developer one month, a mobile developer the next and a data engineer after that, but not all three full time.

With NGSD, a Genixo project manager assigned to your company acts as your software manager, and the Genixo team works as your software department. If you decide to build your own team one day, we hand over the code, the documents and the accumulated knowledge in an orderly way.

sections.label: How it works
sections.title: What working with NGSD looks like

items.title: An assigned project manager
items.text: One person who knows your business, your systems and your priorities, and who is your single point of contact.

items.title: Weekly priorities
items.text: Each week we agree on what matters most. When your needs change, the plan changes with them. [[TODO-032]]

items.title: A weekly demo
items.text: You see working software, not only status reports. Finished, in-progress and blocked items are visible to you.

items.title: Documentation as we go
items.text: Architecture, decisions and operating notes are written down, so knowledge doesn't live only in people's heads.

items.title: The right skill at the right time
items.text: Backend, frontend, mobile, data and AI work are covered by the team as your roadmap requires.

items.text: EU clients usually need a data processing agreement under the GDPR; KVKK applies on the Turkish side. Where data is stored is agreed before work starts. See [data security](/data-security).

items.a: Next Generation Software Department. It is Genixo's model for acting as a company's external software department on an ongoing basis.

items.q: How is NGSD different from outsourcing a project?
items.a: A project has a fixed scope and an end date. NGSD is continuous: priorities are reset with you every week, and the same team keeps the knowledge of your systems over time.

items.q: What happens if we want to build our own team?
items.a: We hand over the code, the documentation and the accumulated knowledge in an orderly way. Notice period and handover details: [[TODO-029]].

items.q: Can NGSD follow a project or pilot?
items.a: Yes. A common path is a fixed-scope project or AI pilot first, then NGSD to keep running and improving what was built.

cta.title: Need software every month, but not a department?
cta.lead: Tell us what's on your roadmap. In the intro call we discuss whether NGSD fits and what the first month would cover.
